description: This file defines a React functional component called RoleCard used within a Next.js application. It displays information about a role, including title, description, skills, responsibilities, and compatibility score. The component also provides interactions such as expanding/collapsing detailed info, setting the role as a target, and navigating to a detailed view in a mindmap. It handles internal state, localStorage synchronization, and API calls to persist user choices.

methods.name: normString
methods.description: Converts a value to a trimmed string, defaulting to empty string for null/undefined.

methods.name: safeStringArray
methods.description: Safely converts an unknown input into a string array, filtering out invalid entries.

methods.name: toBulletedSentences
methods.description: Transforms an array of strings into cleaned, sentence-like strings with proper punctuation.

methods.name: clampPercent
methods.description: Clamps a numeric value between 0 and 100, rounding to nearest integer.

methods.name: roleIdFromRole
methods.description: Extracts a role ID string from role object properties.

methods.name: extractPersonaSkills
methods.description: Retrieves and deduplicates skills from various nested paths within a persona object.

methods.name: normalizeSkillKey
methods.description: Converts a skill string to lowercase and trims whitespace for normalization.

methods.name: intersectSkills
methods.description: Finds intersection of persona skills with required skills, based on normalized keys.

methods.name: RoleCard
methods.description: React component implementing an expandable role card with detailed info and user interactions.
